cues.text: Welcome to the motion sandbox. You will drive a car around a loop, test Newton's laws with crates and balls, and drop things in air and in a vacuum. Predict first, then watch what really happens.
First, kinematics. The race car drives a straight run-up into a loop. Watch the odometer and the displacement arrow.
Now the cargo bay, for Newton's laws. Push crates on the floor and in zero gravity, and watch the collisions. Predict first.
The gravitation bench. Drop things in air and in a vacuum, then explore how two masses pull on each other.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
That is every question on every bench. Open your summary to see how your predictions and explanations went.
